title: Manual workflow UX audit
scope: Native forms, command alternatives, unsupported operations, and recovery. Proposed product changes are not implemented.
evidence_policy: Each finding labels source-only or runtime evidence. Review image bytes, terminal text/styles, and repository assertions separately; publication review is bound to exact artifact hashes.

findings.title: Foreground terminal tools have no handoff lifecycle
findings.concern: Finish or reshape work without losing repository context.
findings.operation: commit, split, absorb, resolve, describe, external command
findings.interaction: Enter a command that needs an editor, interactive selector, or merge tool.
findings.observed_result: Captured execution closes stdin and pipes output; there is no foreground-terminal handoff. Long commands block input; separate-window GUI tools are a different execution case.
findings.recovery: Use an explicitly noninteractive command, or exit jk and run the tool, then reopen and verify.
findings.proposal: Add one foreground tool handoff lifecycle and separate cancellable captured execution.
acceptance_criteria: Restore terminal/input on success, failure, cancellation, and missing executable.
Record exact repository/command and exit or interruption status.
Refresh affected state even when a tool changes the repository before failing.
Prove selected and remaining content for interactive split.

findings.title: Push preview cannot complete publication
findings.interaction: Choose a bookmark and remote, review and execute push dry-run.
findings.observed_result: Dry-run cannot publish, and :git push is rejected. Publication requires re-entering the reviewed bookmark and remote through ! or a shell.
findings.recovery: Cancel before dry-run or leave the native flow to publish; verify remote refs afterward.
findings.proposal: Keep bookmark, remote, and proposal through a distinct publish confirmation and result.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run and cancellation leave the disposable remote unchanged.
Confirmation publishes exactly the selected bookmark.
Changed local/remote state refreshes the proposal.
Rejection retains useful context; remote recovery is not labeled local Undo.

findings.title: File and hunk navigation cannot select mutation content
findings.concern: Move or discard one part of a change.
findings.interaction: Inspect a file or hunk, then open squash or restore.
findings.observed_result: Native mutations affect whole changes/all paths; navigation does not select mutation content.
findings.recovery: Cancel and use explicit noninteractive filesets or an external interactive jj tool; inspect and Undo a completed mistake.
findings.proposal: Share explicit content selection across commit/split and squash/restore, including message choice.
acceptance_criteria: Show selected content and content left behind.
Assert exact content for mixed files, multiple hunks, rename/deletion, and conflicts.
Empty selection and cancellation mutate nothing.
Unselected bytes remain unchanged; Undo restores the prior result.

findings.title: Operand previews require matching hashes to hidden context
findings.concern: Confirm which work will move and where.
findings.operation: rebase, squash, restore, ordered parent/comparison operands
findings.interaction: Choose roles and review the exact command, including at 60 columns.
findings.observed_result: Preview roles use full commit IDs without descriptions; compact rebase controls show unexplained key lists. After multi-parent New, the cursor moves to the new working copy but the parent marks remain; another New reuses those parents.
findings.recovery: Cancel, inspect the changes, and reopen with the intended roles.
findings.proposal: Show change IDs and descriptions beside source/destination roles. Expand compact role controls at narrow widths and label order where it changes the command.
acceptance_criteria: Identify source, destination, scope, and ordering from the active surface.
Review all nine rebase forms at 60 columns.
Distinguish similarly described changes and ordered marks.
Never silently truncate operative identities or command text.
After multi-parent New, make the operands of another immediate New clear; choose and verify an explicit policy for retaining or clearing marks.

findings.title: Abandon diff overrides jj format and styles
findings.concern: Inspect content before abandoning using familiar jj output.
findings.interaction: Open View diff from the abandon confirmation.
findings.observed_result: The query forces Git format and color never; jk repaints plus/minus lines and wraps patch lines.
findings.recovery: Return to the decision and cancel to inspect in the normal Diff view.
findings.proposal: Reuse the normal diff presentation contract or scoped Diff view that returns to the same decision.
acceptance_criteria: Honor custom colors and non-Git default format.
Preserve long code lines with navigation rather than prose wrapping.
Return to the same cancel-default decision after scrolling.
Compare pixels and styled spans at light/dark/narrow sizes.

findings.title: Modal backgrounds retain active cursor emphasis
findings.concern: Know where the next key will go.
findings.operation: modal selection, confirmation, description, Run Options
findings.interaction: Open a dialog over the log.
findings.observed_result: The graph cursor and dialog focus both look active; only the dialog receives input.
findings.recovery: Escape returns to the preserved graph selection; routing still targets the active mode.
findings.proposal: Render overlay backgrounds as inactive while retaining marks, cursor location, and jj colors.
acceptance_criteria: Only the active surface uses focus styling.
Retain actual graph context and opaque filled dialog.
Compare help/actions/describe/abandon/rebase/options/previews at dark/light/narrow sizes.

findings.title: Rebase search cannot find destinations outside the current log
findings.concern: Move work onto a revision hidden by the current filter or limit.
findings.interaction: Open the destination chooser and search for a missing revision.
findings.observed_result: Only loaded log candidates are searched; no distinct candidate can prevent opening; multiple marks are rejected.
findings.recovery: Cancel, widen the log revset/limit, restore source selection, and reopen.
findings.proposal: Retain frozen source roles while resolving an explicit destination or a broader search.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve destinations hidden by revset and log limit.
Distinguish invalid, missing, and ambiguous expressions.
Preserve input and source selection after failure.
Explain search Escape versus dialog Escape.

findings.title: Operation inspection errors are hidden
findings.concern: Understand why an operation detail did not open.
findings.interaction: Open an operation from operation log or Command History while jj lookup fails.
findings.observed_result: The error becomes AppTransition::Continue with no visible failure.
findings.recovery: Inspect Command History for the failed lookup; correct the cause and retry.
findings.proposal: Surface the attempted operation and diagnostic while retaining selection and a retry path.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture failure remains visible on every caller surface.
Preserve full stderr in history/details.
Retry opens the intended operation without changing selection.
Operation inspection from Command History remains usable with a stale on-disk working copy, or reports its failure in that view without silently updating the working copy.

related_observations.observation: After ignore-working-copy or historical mutations leave disk state stale, Command History operation-log fallback can fail. The error handler only updates an active Log view, leaving history unchanged without a diagnostic.
related_observations.evidence_scope: Source-confirmed error routing; failed Run Options recordings stopped at this fallback, while later recordings inspect the retained mutation transcript.

findings.title: Command mode returns to stale repository content
findings.operation: arbitrary jj mutations and external commands
findings.interaction: Run a noninteractive mutation, then return from captured output.
findings.observed_result: RefreshPlan::None leaves the prior view unchanged; command-output refresh gives a Command History limitation.
findings.recovery: Return to the repository view and explicitly refresh before making another decision.
findings.proposal: Refresh after command return or mark affected views stale with one direct repository refresh action.
acceptance_criteria: Verify describe, commit, duplicate, restore, and external file-edit results against jj.
Refresh partial-effect failures as well as success.
Retain captured output and operation links.
Preserve read-only command navigation.

findings.title: Workspace failure discards the retry draft
findings.concern: Correct a path or name without reentering the form.
findings.interaction: Submit an existing destination or colliding name, then try to correct it.
findings.observed_result: A failed add or rename discards the draft and shows only the first error line. Workspace confirmation uses y to execute, while other command previews use y to copy.
findings.recovery: Reopen add/rename and re-enter the intended path/name. For the full diagnostic, open Command History, press Home to select the latest failed command, then Enter; initial selection may be an earlier operation-bearing success.
findings.proposal: Retain the editable draft and diagnostics after failure; apply a consistent confirmation key contract.
acceptance_criteria: Failed add/rename retain editable input and complete diagnostics.
A copy key cannot unexpectedly execute another preview.
Preserve selected workspace after failure.
Opening error details selects the failed command rather than an earlier successful command with an operation ID.

related_observations.observation: Run Options repeats the same invalid-operation validation error twice, though it retains the editable draft.
related_observations.proposal: Show one field error; retain a separate summary only when it adds information.

Every shown bookmark action routes to implemented bookmark/remote behavior.
No workspace-only entries appear in bookmark help/actions.
Actual Workspaces help and actions remain correct.

findings.title: Workspace inspection does not label arbitrary command scope
findings.concern: Avoid changing a different working copy from the one being inspected.
findings.operation: arbitrary jj mutation or executable from sibling workspace inspection
findings.interaction: Inspect sibling status, then enter :describe -m changed @.
findings.observed_result: The command still targets the startup repository while the screen shows sibling workspace content. The prompt omits the execution repository. The corrected CI recording proves default changes, scratch stays unchanged, and native Undo restores default exactly.
findings.recovery: Verify execution repository before running; inspect operation history and Undo in the affected repository if needed.
findings.proposal: Show execution workspace/repository before every arbitrary command; retain startup scope or provide an explicit scoped handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Two sibling fixture workspaces have distinct working-copy descriptions.
Prompt, command, output, history, and actual changed working copy agree.
Exercise log/status/diff entry points and relative paths through !.
Never silently switch execution policy based on the view.

findings.title: Retry editing requires deleting the command tail
findings.concern: Correct one operand in a failed command.
findings.interaction: Open edit from captured output and try to move to a middle operand.
findings.observed_result: Input supports append, Backspace, and clear-all; cursor and word movement are ignored.
findings.recovery: Backspace through the suffix or Ctrl-u and reenter the command.
findings.proposal: Reuse a cursor-based text input model with word movement, deletion, Unicode, and horizontal scrolling.
acceptance_criteria: Change a middle operand without changing the suffix.
Retry preserves original input.
Assert exact argument vector after Unicode editing and scrolling.

findings.title: Bookmark mutation success has no factual completion cue
findings.interaction: Confirm the mutation and return to the refreshed list.
findings.observed_result: Success refreshes without showing prepared success_message; status clears unless selection disappeared.
findings.recovery: Compare the target/list and inspect Command History.
findings.proposal: Show the bookmark/target result, preserve useful selection, and link Command History.
acceptance_criteria: Verify create in a long list, move, and delete.

findings.title: Captured output clips the execution command and long lines
findings.concern: Inspect the full command and diagnostic before deciding what to do next.
findings.operation: Captured jj or external command; command-history details
findings.interaction: Run or inspect a command with a long repository path or quoted operands.
findings.observed_result: Long repository paths hide the command and operands beyond the right edge. Rendered output has vertical scrolling only; the full command remains available through Command History copy or edit/retry.
findings.recovery: Copy the recorded command from Command History, or edit/retry to retain the original arguments; recorded data is intact.
findings.proposal: Wrap command metadata or make it scrollable, and provide an explicit full-text or horizontal navigation path for raw output.
acceptance_criteria: Show the whole execution command with long paths and quoted operands at 60 and 104 columns.
Preserve stdout/stderr/code whitespace while making long lines inspectable.
Copy exact arguments and exclude chrome.

findings.title: Escape quits inspection instead of returning
findings.concern: Return from command output or nested inspection without losing navigation context.
findings.operation: captured jj/external command and workspace/operation inspection
findings.interaction: Press Escape after reading output, using the same key that dismisses a prompt or preview.
findings.observed_result: The shared key mapping treats Escape as Quit; static rendered, workspace and operation views propagate it to application exit. Backspace pops one view. Failed recordings caught unintended exit before recovery.
findings.recovery: Reopen jk and reconstruct the view stack; use Backspace to return one level while the application is still open.
findings.proposal: Adopt one visible back/cancel contract for nested views, reserving an explicit quit action for leaving the application. Preserve appropriate prompt cancellation and top-level exit behavior.
acceptance_criteria: From nested output, history details, workspace status/log/diff and operation show/diff, the displayed Back key returns exactly one level without quitting.
Prompt cancel and preview cancel leave repository state unchanged.
An explicit Quit key remains available and is distinguished from Back in help/footer.
Capture a command failure, return to its origin, retry, and verify recovery without restarting jk.

findings.title: Diff navigation requires incompatible file and hunk headers
findings.concern: Navigate the files and hunks visible in the patch.
findings.operation: diff file listing, file jumps/folds, hunk jumps/folds
findings.interaction: Open a real --git diff and its file picker, or try hunk navigation on real --color-words output.
findings.observed_result: The Git patch is populated but the file dialog says No files in this diff. File parsing recognizes color-words headers only; hunk parsing then requires @@ inside recognized sections. Git provides @@ without recognized file headers, and color-words provides file headers without @@. The recording that claimed successful hunk folding lacked a folded marker and is rejected as tutorial evidence.
findings.recovery: Use color-words for supported file navigation/folding, scroll/search raw Git output, and inspect hunks outside the advertised navigation until the parser is corrected.
findings.proposal: Build file/hunk navigation from a format-aware structure covering actual jj output, or derive semantic anchors separately while retaining the chosen patch rendering. Disable or explain unsupported controls rather than reporting an empty file set.
acceptance_criteria: Use unmodified real jj --git and --color-words output fixtures; avoid synthetic mixed-format headers.
List and jump among multiple files for each supported format, including renames and binary changes.
Hunk navigation/folding reaches distinct real hunks and visibly preserves context; formats without hunk anchors clearly state the limit.
Switch format and refresh while preserving valid selection; no populated patch is described as having no files.

findings.title: Container startup misses current jj no-working-copy output
findings.concern: Start jk from a shared repository container and inspect its default child workspace.
findings.interaction: Run bare jk in a no-working-copy container with a default child using tested jj 0.45.1.
findings.observed_result: With jj 0.45.1, status prints "No working copy." but the resolver matches "No working copy" without the period. It skips child selection. Explicit -R default works.
findings.recovery: Run jk -R default from the container or change into the intended child workspace before launching.
findings.proposal: Detect the no-working-copy state through a stable structured capability when available; otherwise normalize the specific supported diagnostic conservatively and preserve other errors.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise actual jj 0.45.1 output with trailing punctuation and supported older variants.
A default child is chosen deterministically; fallback child selection is verified when no default exists.
An explicit -R remains authoritative.
Unrelated jj errors never trigger silent selection of another repository.
Capture startup from container and child plus a mutation-scope assertion in the resolved workspace.
